```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr) 

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 15))
source("code/R/visualization.R")
source("code/R/utils.R")
```


## Data import
### Palette
```{r}
palette_df <- read.csv("metadata/clean/project_palette.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
palette <- setNames(palette_df$color, palette_df$label)
```

### Cohort data
```{r}
taxa_df <- read.csv("processed_data/genus_ra_non_rare.csv") %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id")
colnames(taxa_df) <- colnames(taxa_df) %>% gsub(".*g__","",.)
```

```{r}
mdata <- read.csv("metadata/clean/core_metadata_with_mean.csv") %>% 
         mutate(phenotype_binary = ifelse(phenotype %in% c("Classical FAP", "Non-classical FAP"), "FAP", "Control"),
                phenotype_binary = factor(phenotype_binary , levels = c("FAP", "Control")),
                cohort = "Internal") %>% 
         filter(sample_id %in% rownames(taxa_df)) 
patient_mdata <- mdata %>% select(-sample_id, -batch) %>% unique()
mdata %>% head()
```

### Katona et.al

```{r}
katona <- read.csv("qiime/katona/6_Taxonomy_GTDB/feature_table.tsv", sep = "\t" ) %>% 
          filter(stringr::str_detect(taxon , ";g__.+", )) %>%
          tibble::column_to_rownames("taxon") %>%  mutate_all(~ . / sum(.)) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(katona) <- colnames(katona) %>% gsub(".*;g__","",.)
```

```{r}
katona_mdata <- read.csv("metadata/clean/katona_et_al.csv") %>% 
                rename(sample_id = sample) %>% filter(sample_id %in% rownames(katona))
colnames(katona_mdata) <- colnames(katona_mdata) %>% tolower()
katona_mdata <- katona_mdata %>% select(-tissuetype, -bioproject, -sample_identifier) %>% 
                mutate(phenotype_binary = ifelse(study_group == "Polyposis", "FAP", "Control"),
                       cohort = "Katona")
                
katona_mdata %>% head()
```

```{r}
katona_mdata %>% count(gene_group)
katona_mdata %>% count(study_group)
```


```{r}
katona_filt <- remove_rare_features(katona, prevalence_cutoff = 0.1,
                                                avg_abundance_cutoff = 0.0005,
                                                rescale = T) %>% as.data.frame()
write.csv(katona_filt %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id"),"processed_data/katona_non_rare.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
### combine metadata
```{r}
shared_cols <- base::intersect(colnames(mdata), colnames(katona_mdata))
core_mdata <- rbind(mdata %>% select(shared_cols), katona_mdata %>% select(shared_cols))
write.csv(core_mdata, "metadata/clean/core_metadata_cross_cohort.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Analysis
```{r}
shared_genera <- intersect(colnames(katona_filt), colnames(taxa_df))
print(paste("Number of shared genera:",length(shared_genera)))
```

```{r}
taxa_df_sub <- taxa_df %>% select(shared_genera) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate_all(~ . / sum(.))

katona_sub <- katona_filt %>% select(shared_genera) %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate_all(~ . / sum(.))
```

```{r}
comb <- rbind(taxa_df_sub %>% t() %>% as.matrix(),
                  katona_sub %>% t() %>% as.matrix()) #%>% as.matrix()# %>% t()
comb[is.na(comb)] <- 0
genus_dist <- vegan::vegdist(comb, method = "bray") %>% as.matrix()
```




```{r}
pcoa_df <- get_pcoa(genus_dist, 2)
eig_vals <- pcoa_df[[1]]
pcoa_df <- pcoa_df[[2]] %>% left_join(core_mdata, by = "sample_id")

# Plot PCs 1 and 2 by phenotype
ggp <- ggplot(pcoa_df %>% mutate(label = paste(phenotype_binary, cohort)),aes(axis_1, axis_2,  color =label)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) #+ scale_color_manual(values = palette) 

plot(ggp)
```

## Comparison of percentile-normalized data (generated in the notebook python/percentile_normalization.ipynb)

```{r}
perc_int <- read.csv("qiime/batch_correct/genus_ra_non_rare_perc_norm.tsv", sep = "\t") %>% rename(sample_id = "X")
colnames(perc_int) <- colnames(perc_int) %>% gsub(".*g__","",.)
perc_kat <- read.csv("qiime/batch_correct/katona_non_rare_perc_norm.tsv", sep = "\t") %>% rename(sample_id = "X")
```

```{r}
perc_df <- rbind(perc_int %>% select(all_of(c("sample_id",shared_genera))),
                 perc_kat %>% select(all_of(c("sample_id",shared_genera))))

perc_df_long <- perc_df %>% 
           tidyr::pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "genus", values_to = "perc_norm") %>% 
           left_join(core_mdata, by = "sample_id")
```


```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
ggplot(perc_df_long %>% filter(phenotype_binary == "FAP"), aes(x = genus, y = perc_norm, fill = cohort))  + 
  geom_boxplot() + labs(x = "", y = "Percentile relative to control") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom") 
```

```{r}
fap_samples <- core_mdata %>% filter(phenotype_binary == "FAP") %>% pull(sample_id)
pca <- get_pca(perc_df %>% filter(sample_id %in% fap_samples) %>%  tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id"),2)
eig_vals <- pca[[1]]
pca_df <- pca[[2]] %>% left_join(core_mdata, by = "sample_id")
loadings <- pca[[3]]

plot_pca(pca_df, 1,2,eig_vals, "cohort")
```
